headline: Tech rebounded on CoreWeave's beat and an Nvidia bounce, but a strong dollar tempers the lean.
brief: The Nasdaq Composite rose 1.60% to 25,466, closing mid-range after CoreWeave's results lifted AI names and Nvidia gained about 5%; VIX fell about 10% to 17.5. Bond markets were shut for Veterans Day, while the dollar hit its strongest level since April 2025 as USD/JPY neared 160. Asia-session catalysts look light tonight; key risks are yen intervention talk, Fed-hike repricing and Nvidia headlines.
